# US Pharmacopeia (USP)

> USP is a non-profit scientific organization that establishes and maintains quality standards for pharmaceuticals, dietary supplements, compounding, biologics, and food products globally.

USP develops the USP-NF (United States Pharmacopeia and National Formulary), the official compendium of quality standards recognized by regulatory agencies worldwide. The organization operates through volunteer expert committees, maintains reference standards and testing services, and operates regional offices across the United States and internationally including India, Brazil, and China.

## About USP

- [US Pharmacopeia (USP)](https://www.usp.org): USP homepage: standards setting for pharmaceuticals, compounding, biologics and global health
- [About the U.S. Pharmacopeia](https://www.usp.org/about): Overview of USP as non-profit scientific organization setting pharmaceutical and food standards
- [USP Leadership](https://www.usp.org/about/leadership): USP executive team, Board of Trustees, Council of Experts and organizational leadership
- [USP Convention](https://www.usp.org/about/usp-convention): USP Convention governing body electing Board of Trustees and Council of Experts every five years
- [Legal Recognition of USP Standards](https://www.usp.org/about/legal-recognition): Legal recognition of USP standards globally for medicines, dietary supplements and food

## Standards Development & Expert Committees

- [USP Volunteers](https://www.usp.org/about/volunteer-experts): USP volunteer expert program for standards development in medicines, supplements and food
- [Expert Committees 2025-2030](https://www.usp.org/about/volunteer-experts/expert-committees-2025-2030): USP Expert Committees for 2025-2030 covering biologics, gene therapy and pharmaceutical standards
- [Expert Committee and Panel Meetings](https://www.usp.org/about/volunteer-experts/expert-committee-meetings): Expert Committee meetings developing and revising USP-NF standards for medicines and foods

## Products & Services

- [USP Store](https://store.usp.org/home): USP Store for reference standards, testing services and performance verification products
- [Complex Generics](https://www.usp.org/complex-generics): Complex generic medicines guidance covering inhalers, injectables and extractables testing
- [Medicines Supply Chain](https://www.usp.org/supply-chain): USP Resiliency Center investigating pharmaceutical supply chain disruption and resilience

## Global Operations

- [USP–India](https://www.usp.org/india): USP-India office in Hyderabad enabling collaborative opportunities with Indian pharmaceutical and food sectors
- [Other USP Locations](https://www.usp.org/other-locations): Global USP locations and regional offices across Brazil, China, Switzerland and other countries

## Support & Resources

- [Browse Help Topics](https://www.usp.org/help): Help topics, customer support and contact information for USP products and services
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)](https://www.usp.org/frequently-asked-questions): FAQs covering USP standards, USP-NF, compounding, testing and reference standards
- [Contact Us](http://www.usp.org/contact-us): USP contact information for Rockville, Frederick and international office locations
- [Newsroom](https://www.usp.org/about/newsroom): USP newsroom with press releases, Quality Matters blog and medicine supply information
